message.subject: Extending performance beyond 12 years
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the DPD fleet project—wrapping 30,000 vehicles is no small feat.

I'm reaching out because we're seeing more RFPs for architectural and transit projects requiring 15-20 year warranties, which seems to be pushing beyond what current cast vinyl can deliver. We work with protective overlaminates that help companies extend their product performance into those ultra-premium segments.

Would it make sense to explore how this could fit into your innovation pipeline? Happy to share some technical details on the chemistry behind it.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: The 30,000-vehicle DPD fleet project represents both a success story and validates their scale in fleet graphics, while current 12-year lifespan limit creates opportunity gap for longer-warranty segments
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extending product lifespan beyond current cast vinyl limitations to access ultra-premium architectural and transit segments requiring 15-20 year warranties
